candidate_rule: max(original full-label cosine, canonical operation+object cosine) >= 0.44; existing conflict filter; operation guard only when both operations are resolved
threshold_decision: No additional operation threshold. The best-F1 plateau does not remove the remaining lifecycle negatives, while a higher cutoff rejects defensible cross-operation paraphrases. Operation similarity is retained as inspectable evidence; the frozen conflict map remains the compatibility guard.
